_comment: Navigation menu emitted by the (future) fetch script. Shape: { brand: {es,en}, items: [{ label:{es,en}, href, anchor? }] }. `anchor:true` means the href is an on-page anchor (e.g. '#work') that scroll-jumps when already on the home page and otherwise links to '/<href>'. Consumed by src/app/components/Navigation.tsx.
